top.titulo: Britain Finally Creates an Oil Wealth Fund—50 Years Too Late
top.resumen_es: The United Kingdom has finally established an oil-backed investment fund, decades after neighboring Norway began transforming its North Sea petroleum revenues into one of the world's largest sovereign wealth funds. The British government's new £2 billion Energy Wealth Fund, announced Wednesday alongside approval of the Jackdaw gas field, will channel North Sea oil and gas tax revenues into renewable energy and low-carbon infrastructure.
